meta.how_to: The source of truth for what we are doing. Edit it with `python -m gm progress set <id> key=value ...` (or by hand), then run `python -m gm progress build`. PROGRESS.md and progress.html are GENERATED from this file - never edit them. `status` is where the work is; `awaiting` is WHOSE TURN IT IS; a backlog card has awaiting "none" because nobody is holding it yet.

tasks.title: Saved key bindings dispatch a random script (the scr_drawTimerExt crash)
tasks.needs: Close and reload GameMaker (LL-008), then run: the per-step "Variable Input._objSwitch not set before reading it" spam must be gone, and WASD must still move the player.
tasks.notes: key_type holds function references (scr_key_get, scr_gamepad_get, ...) but scr_save_keys persisted the array through ds_list_write, which cannot represent a function. On the next launch scr_load_keys restored plain numbers (about 100417) into key_type, and Input/Step_0 did script_execute(key_type[i], key_code[i]) - GameMaker ran whatever script that number indexes, which was scr_drawTimerExt, an asset-pack script that reads _objSwitch, an object never recovered into this project. Fixed: scr_save_keys no longer persists key_type; scr_load_keys rejects a loaded key_type that is not all-callable and keeps the freshly built one; Input/Step_0 only script_execute()s a callable; scr_drawTimerExt resolves _objSwitch with asset_get_index and bails when absent. Written up as LL-026.

tasks.title: A saved key_type restores callable-but-stale - never read it
tasks.needs: Reload GameMaker (LL-008), then run: Input must stop throwing Variable <object>.<var> not set before reading it from a script its Step event never calls, and WASD/ESC/gamepad must still respond.
tasks.notes: The LL-026 error returned, naming a different script and an unrelated object (obj_spawn) - because adding run_script shifted the script table. Decoding the save file [KeyInputData] 1 showed the key_type entries are type-marker 15 (not 5=real) holding 100417/100415: ds_list_write/read DO survive a function reference, as a value that is STILL CALLABLE, so scr_load_keys is_callable guard passed and key_type became the stale array; the dispatch then ran whatever script the handle now indexed. run_script guard cannot detect it (not undefined, not a number, not non-callable). Fix: scr_load_keys/scr_load_gamepad no longer read slot 1 at all; scr_save_keys/save_gamepad blank slot 1 so an older build cannot read it either. The live save was purged (backup /tmp/test.data.bak-before-purge). Written up as LL-028, which corrects LL-026 premise.

tasks.title: Plants block one 32x32 grid cell, not a 2x2
tasks.needs: Reload GameMaker (LL-008), play a wave, and confirm the horde leaves the walled pen and takes the route you expect; place a tower and check it blocks only the cell it sits on.
tasks.notes: mp_grid_add_rectangle/add_instances floor BOTH edges and iterate INCLUSIVELY, so the tower rect x+-16 (far edge on the next cell boundary) marked a 2x2 - as did any instance whose bbox far edge landed on a boundary. Fixed: obj_tower Create/Destroy block and clear the ONE cell (grid_col/grid_row) by index; obj_tower_edit does the same for the candidate and per existing blocker; a new scr_grid_block_instances() replaces mp_grid_add_instances over the live grid in scr_resetDrawPath and obj_mon/Alarm_0 (one cell per instance, from x/y). The walled pen around the spawn has a one-cell exit that over-blocked walls could seal. Written up as LL-027.

tasks.title: Fix the tower-card crash: tower_upgrade_price / tower_sell_refund were never defined
tasks.notes: Selecting a tower threw 'Variable _levelControl.tower_upgrade_price not set before reading it' at _levelControl/Step_0.gml:94. The Phase 1 economy refactor wired the call sites but never added the two functions. Defined both in tower_levels.gml: tower_upgrade_price(base, level) counts rungs from the garden FLOOR and returns -1 at the cap (economy.md 4.3); tower_sell_refund(invested) is 60% of everything invested.

tasks.title: Zombies walk north through the walls when their path is destroyed
tasks.needs: Reload the project, play a wave with global.devMode = true, and watch the horde: no zombie should leave the route or cross a wall, and the log should show no 'monster(s) still alive 6s past the wave' valve line. Paste anything that still drifts.
tasks.notes: A tower placed near the horde forced a re-path (Collision_obj_tower fires on proximity). Alarm_0 called path_end() and path_clear_points(myPath) BEFORE it asked the grid, so one failed re-path left the monster with no path - and a monster with no path is a monster nothing rewrites each step. obj_mon/Draw_72 (Pre Draw) and Draw_73 (Post Draw) both did 'y -= z_climb*2-12', a draw-only offset applied twice, so with no path follower to reset y the zombie stepped north ~16-24px a frame, straight through the walls, and once off-grid it could never re-path again. Fixed: Draw_73 restores (y += ...), scr_path_replace() probes into a scratch path and only commits when a route exists (so the last valid path is kept), and obj_tower now blocks/clears the SAME cell rectangle (the old code blocked bbox at scale 1 and cleared at 0.5, leaking phantom blocked cells).

tasks.title: All script_execute dispatch goes through run_script()
tasks.needs: Reload GameMaker (LL-008), then play: menus, buttons, towers, zombies and the wave path preview must all still behave; place a tower and swap input device.
tasks.notes: Replaced every script_execute() (14 sites, 12 files) with one run_script(script_name, target=noone, arguments_list=[]). It returns undefined unless the name is neither undefined nor non-callable, binds via method(target, script_name) when target != noone and instance_exists(target) so the call runs in that instance scope, and otherwise runs in the caller scope. GML has no argument spread, so arguments_list is forwarded through a switch on array_length (0..4 - the widest site, for_grid, passes 4); anything longer logs via scr_meta_log rather than failing silently. Sites: Input/Step_0, scr_runState, scr_stpButton, scr_updateReciever, for_array/for_dgrid/for_2darray/for_grid/for_collGrid, _oTextInput Create/Step/Draw. run_script is not a GameMaker built-in (LL-005 checked).

log.what: Fixed the per-frame 'Unable to find instance for object index 1': a persistent instance whose dependency did not persist.
One level object (GameLevelData) and a deploy gate the level data can pass, so the world map cannot offer a stage that has no data.
Waves became a rule (15 + 5 a stage, all six biomes) and the ramp became region_data's per-biome curve, replacing the exponential that hit x1036 at wave 60.
The 4.4 ladder: a level is base x ladder and never compounds; cap and floor come from the garden; rungs are re-priced and selling refunds 60% of what went in.
The difficulty columns are read at last - hp, speed, count, money and starting money. Before this, Brutal only paid better; it never fought harder.
Found that 4.3's prices and 4.4's ladder disagree: a rung returns +0.16 dps per unit of money against +1.00 for another placement. Written up as economy.md 4.6 and left open for a decision.
Built the progress tracker: progress.json as the source, PROGRESS.md and progress.html generated from it, and gm progress check failing when the three disagree.
Tightened the tracker: a backlog card may no longer be awaiting a person, because the top strip filled with parked work within the hour (LL-023).

Fixed the tower-card crash: the Phase 1 economy refactor called tower_upgrade_price() and tower_sell_refund() but never defined them, so selecting a tower died at _levelControl/Step_0.gml:94. Both now live in tower_levels.gml beside tower_rung_cost().

Closed the 'commit the curve work' card: every file it said was untracked is already committed in HEAD and git status is clean, so the card had gone stale. Noted the LL-024 lesson (a call to an undefined function reports as a variable read in the CALLER's scope).

Zombies marched north through the walls. obj_mon/Draw_72 (Pre Draw) and Draw_73 (Post Draw) both subtracted z_climb*2-12 - a draw-only offset applied twice - and Alarm_0 threw the live path away (path_end + path_clear_points) before asking the grid for a new one, so one failed re-path left the monster with no path and nothing rewriting its y. Draw_73 now restores the offset, and scr_path_replace() probes a scratch path and only commits on success, so the last valid path is kept. Also made the tower's grid block and its clear the same rectangle. Written up as LL-025.

Fixed the Input._objSwitch crash. key_type holds function references, but scr_save_keys persisted it through ds_list_write, which cannot represent a function - so on the next launch key_type came back as numbers and Input/Step_0's script_execute() ran whatever script that number indexed (scr_drawTimerExt, which reads the unrecovered _objSwitch). scr_save_keys no longer saves key_type, scr_load_keys rejects a non-callable loaded key_type and keeps the freshly built one, Input/Step_0 only script_execute()s a callable, and scr_drawTimerExt resolves _objSwitch with asset_get_index and bails when absent. Written up as LL-026.

Pathfinding was still wrong after LL-025. mp_grid_add_rectangle and mp_grid_add_instances floor BOTH edges and iterate INCLUSIVELY, so the tower's x+-cell_w/2 rectangle - whose far edge lands exactly on the next cell boundary - marked a 2x2 block instead of the one 32x32 cell it occupies (and any instance whose bbox far edge hit a boundary over-blocked the same way, which is how the walled pen's one-cell exit could seal). Fixed: obj_tower Create/Destroy block and clear exactly one cell by index (grid_col/grid_row); obj_tower_edit blocks one cell for the candidate and one per existing blocker; a new scr_grid_block_instances() replaces mp_grid_add_instances over the live grid in scr_resetDrawPath and obj_mon/Alarm_0. Written up as LL-027.

Replaced every script_execute() in the project (14 call sites across 12 files) with a new run_script(script_name, target=noone, arguments_list=[]). It returns undefined unless the name passes !is_undefined() && is_callable(); when target != noone and instance_exists(target) it re-binds with method(target, script_name) so the call runs in that instance's scope, otherwise it runs in the caller's scope as script_execute() did. GML has no argument spread, so arguments_list is forwarded through a switch on array_length (0..4 - the widest site, for_grid, passes 4) and a longer list logs via scr_meta_log instead of failing silently. Sites: Input/Step_0 (the LL-026 dispatch), scr_runState, scr_stpButton, scr_updateReciever, the for_* iterators, and _oTextInput Create/Step/Draw. run_script is not a GameMaker built-in (LL-005 checked); LL-026's guard rails now point at it.

Chased the Input crash that appeared after the run_script migration: 'Variable obj_spawn.time_keeper not set before reading it' from scr_drawSwitchTimer, called by Input/Step_0 -> run_script. Decoding the save file showed [KeyInputData] 1 still holds the listeners as type-marker-15 values (100417/100415), i.e. ds_list_write/read DOES round-trip a function reference - it comes back as a value that is STILL CALLABLE, so scr_load_keys' is_callable() guard passed and key_type was replaced by the stale array; the dispatch then ran whatever script the old handle now indexes (scr_drawTimerExt for LL-026, scr_drawSwitchTimer once run_script added a script). run_script()'s guard cannot see it: the value is not undefined, not a number and not non-callable. Fix: scr_load_keys/scr_load_gamepad no longer read slot 1, and scr_save_keys/scr_save_gamepad blank it so an older build cannot read it either; the live save file was purged too. Written up as LL-028, which corrects LL-026's premise that the value comes back as a plain number.
